_comment: Field elevation in FEET MSL, by pydcs airport name, per map. pydcs carries no elevation at all — ParkingSlot.height is the stand's clearance height (6-18 m), which pattern.py mistook for elevation until v1.107.0; at Nellis that put pattern landers 1,800 ft underground. These are real-world published field elevations; DCS's terrain agrees within a few feet. `source` says where each map's numbers come from — 'ours' means read from aviation references by hand and NOT yet checked against the sim. A field absent here has NO elevation on record: the pattern block then skips airborne spawns at that field and says so, rather than guessing. To add a map: dump `land.getHeight(Airbase.getPoint())` for every airbase from a DCS mission script, convert to feet, and cite it.
